map.收获期安排、劳动力需求、机械效率计算、进度规划: Harvest scheduling, labor demand, machine efficiency, and progress planning
map.总产量 = 面积 × 单产 ÷ 1000（吨）；日作业量 = 面积 ÷ 计划天数: Total output = area x yield / 1000 (t); daily work = area / planned days; labor = ceil(daily work / (per-capita daily efficiency x hours/8)); machines = ceil(daily work / machine daily efficiency)
map.按收获方式规划用工与机械：人工收获按「日作业量 ÷ 人均日效率」定人数；机械收获: Plan labor and machines by harvest method: manual by "daily work / per-capita daily efficiency" for headcount; machine by "daily work / machine daily efficiency" for unit count; combined uses 70%/30% area split. Cost uses labor hourly fee and machine per-mu fee, converted to per-area and per-output cost (yuan/kg).
map.= 每天工作小时 × 每小时收获效率: = working hours per day x hourly harvest efficiency
map.= 总面积 ÷ (人工日收获量 × 天数): = total area / (manual daily harvest x days)
map.谷物最佳收获期为蜡熟末期，过早青粒多、产量低: Best grain harvest is late waxy stage; too early means many green grains and low yield
map.过晚易落粒、发芽，品质下降: Too late risks shattering and sprouting, lower quality
map.应关注天气预报，避开雨天收获: Watch the forecast and avoid rainy harvest
map.收获后及时晾晒，含水量降至安全标准（小麦12.5%、水稻13.5%、玉米14%）: Dry promptly after harvest to safe moisture (wheat 12.5%, rice 13.5%, corn 14%)
map.：三夏（夏收、夏种、夏管）和三秋（秋收、秋种、秋管）农时紧张，应提前做好机械调度: : the "three summers" (summer harvest, planting, management) and "three autumns" (autumn harvest, planting, management) are tight; schedule machines and labor ahead.
map.按各地块成熟度（GDD/含水率）与机械资源排程收获顺序。: Schedule harvest order by plot maturity (GDD/moisture) and machine resources.
map.平衡『先熟先收』与『避雨抢收』。: Balance "first ripe, first cut" and "grab harvest before rain".
map.用于多地块、多品种协同调度。: Used for coordinated scheduling of multiple plots and varieties.
map.A 地 3 天后达蜡熟、B 地 6 天、C 地 9 天；一台收割机日作业 80: Plot A ripe in 3 days, B in 6, C in 9; one harvester does 80 mu/day. Prioritize A->B->C; if rain on day 5, bring B forward and delay C to avoid A and B both over-ripening and shattering.
map.不能全替代。它把『成熟度、机械、天气』量化排程，但临田判断（倒伏、病斑）仍需人定: Not fully. It quantifies "maturity, machines, weather" into a schedule, but field judgment (lodging, disease spots) still needs humans. It aids decisions, not auto-execution.
map.机械故障怎么办？: What if a machine breaks down?
map.规划应留缓冲（如日作业按 70% 能力排），并预备代耕或跨区调配。关键期『宁可早: Leave a buffer in planning (e.g., schedule daily work at 70% capacity) and prepare substitute or cross-region dispatch. At critical times "better slightly early than late and shattered".
map.收获规划器是一款农业种植领域的在线工具。农业种植工具，帮助计算种植参数与产量。: The Harvest Planner is an online agricultural tool that helps calculate planting parameters and yield.
